description: Get the paginated list of campaign donors (individuals and PACs) for a single politician across one election cycle: the full donor list behind questions like "who donated to <politician>". Returns donor name, amount, type, employer/occupation (individuals), and committee details (PACs).

cycle.description: Election cycle as 4-digit year (e.g. "2024"). Defaults to most recent cycle. FEC cycles are even years (2022, 2024, 2026); an odd year matches no cycle and returns no donors, and a year outside 1980-2100 is replaced by the current cycle.

minAmount.description: Minimum contribution amount in USD (filters out small donors)

name: get_politician_donors
title: Get Politician Donors
